text.en:
While moving at a minimum of 2 meters per second:
Gain a Stack after 2 seconds and an additional Stack after 10 seconds.

Removes all stacks if movement speed is below 2 meters per second for 0.5 seconds.

Can activate and remain active while stowed.

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e Grace period for not meeting the criteria is increased to 1 second. Perpetual Motion x2 is activated in 9 seconds.
)

< table >
|     Time Spent Moving          |   Stability              | Reload                      | Handling <bold/>
|     #e 2-${10-#d} seconds               |   +5                     | +5                           | +5       <background/>
|2-2c In-game  values:           |-2 <formula [reload_0] /> | <formula Ready: [ready_0] />
|     <formula Stow: [stow_0] />
|     #e ${10-#d}+ seconds                |   +15                    | +15                          | +15      <background/>
|2-2c In-game  values:           |-2 <formula [reload_1] /> | <formula Ready: [ready_1] />
|     <formula Stow: [stow_1] />
<$>
text.zh-chs:
保持移动时(每秒移动 2 米以上)时：
2 秒后触发第一层增益，10秒后触发第二层增益。

每 0.5 秒检测一次状态，若没有保持移动，则失去所有增益层数。

武器收起时也可触发和保持该增益。

enhanced (
var d = 1
#e 触发第二层增益所需时间降低到 9 秒。持续检测移动状态的时长从 0.5 秒提升到 1 秒。
)

< table >
|     保持移动的时长          |   稳定性              | 填装速度                      | 操控性 <bold/>
|     #e 2-${10-#d} 秒               |   +5                     | +5                           | +5       <background/>
|2-2c 游戏内数值：           |-2 <formula [reload_0] /> | <formula 拔枪： [ready_0] />
|     <formula 收枪： [stow_0] />
|     #e ${10-#d}+ 秒                |   +15                    | +15                          | +15      <background/>
|2-2c 游戏内数值           |-2 <formula [reload_1] /> | <formula 拔枪： [ready_1] />
|     <formula 收枪： [stow_1] />
<$>

While moving at a minimum of 2 meters per second:
Gain a Stack after 2 and #e${10-#d} seconds.

Each stack provides 10 Stability, 10 Handling, and 10 Reload Speed. All stacks are removed if movement speed is below 2 m/s for 0.5 seconds.

Works and can activate while stowed.

#e Second Stack is gained 1 second sooner.
